purpose: Current implementation coverage and pre-Unity readiness map; documentation reconciliation only, not rule authority, new module acceptance, scope reduction or permission to start development.
currentStatusPrecedence: This map's current fields supersede historical status/count text in RULE_MAP.json and the legacy tables of IMPLEMENTATION_TRACE.md. Exact source-specific acceptance records govern their slices; original dependency edges and acceptance text are unchanged.

hold.allowed: Confer with GPT and update/review/commit the map only.
hold.prohibited: Do not start or prepare the next implementation module, Unity integration, storage cleanup or Support.
hold.nextRecordedGate: Return the complete amended CHR-05 Consecrate/Consecrated Ground source/API contract for actual review; HELD, not begun by this update.

statusLegend.TECHNICAL_BASELINE: Established and exercised technical baseline for admitted commands/profiles; not universal coverage or whole-engine completion.
statusLegend.SUPPORT_ONLY: Technical fixture support, never a substitute for sourced gameplay.
statusLegend.PARTIAL: Named implemented/accepted slices exist; the broader workstream still has explicit remaining scope.
statusLegend.NO_ACCEPTED_RUNTIME_IDENTIFIED: No accepted gameplay slice identified in this reviewed map/evidence; an evidence finding, not a claim that no related code exists.
statusLegend.MIXED_CSHARP_AND_LATER_UNITY: Some C# contracts are accepted; remaining C# scope and later presentation work must be tracked separately.

readiness.whyNoPercentage: 49 workstreams vary in size and remain partly bounded; catalogue counts and passing tests are not a coverage denominator. Required coverage and operating envelopes are not yet finite signed-off contracts.
readiness.scopePolicy: Preserve the full reusable-engine mandate. The accepted connected minimum does not satisfy it. Do not silently require every catalogue identity to execute before Unity, nor silently exclude mapped capabilities. Define and review the exact required coverage; material reductions/product choices/production promotion need owner direction, while routine technical criteria and rule gaps retain the existing Codex/GPT consensus process.

gates.title: Finite required C# capability and content coverage
gates.remaining: Turn the 49 workstream remainders into a finite required capability/rule-family/content/interaction matrix. Explicitly disposition every required identity or family as implemented, unsupported with a reason, or later by authorized scope decision. Define first-integration authority/profile. Catalogue inventories alone do not settle this boundary.
gates.closure: Reviewed coverage matrix preserving the full goal, exact mandatory behaviors/representative content, exclusions and their authority. No silent reduction to the current loop and no invented all-catalogue execution obligation.

gates.remaining: Complete each required open capability in the 49 rows after UR-01 resolves inclusion, following the unchanged graph and scoped prerequisite reviews. gates.title: Connected behavior and independent semantic coverage
gates.remaining: Preserve the accepted INT-03 loop and INT-04 recipe4 proof. Qualify required additional branches/interactions defined by UR-01 through shared state, finite resources and actual independent source expectations.

gates.remaining: Retain the named supported-profile/version matrix and requalify added capabilities/operating envelopes. Preserve canonical state, RNG, work, source history, exact retries, atomic rejection, privacy and backup recovery.

gates.remaining: Keep canonical/provisional/TEST_ONLY/production statuses distinct. Decide the exact authorized content and rule profile for first Unity gameplay integration and expose unresolved cadence/geometry/traversal policies where approval is only bounded prototype scope.

gates.title: Complete required headless host/query/explanation contracts
gates.remaining: Cover required commands, available choices, source-faithful result explanations and filtered public views for the UR-01 scope. Preserve Unity-independent authority; distinguish unsupported discovery/query paths from implemented commands.

gates.title: Actual whole-C# completion review and phase transition
gates.remaining: After the required scope and preceding gates are proven, reconcile every requirement against retained evidence and obtain actual GPT/Codex agreement that the C# milestone is met before beginning Unity gameplay integration.
gates.closure: A final requirement-by-requirement completion record names remaining authorized exclusions, source authority, supported saves and measured operating limits. Module approvals and this map review do not substitute for that decision.

laterUnityAndProduct.work: Import/compile the Decennium package in the Editor; hook up the authoritative simulation adapter, scenes, input and presentation. Existing Editor/template preparation is not this qualification.
Actual Edit Mode, Play Mode, lifecycle/re-entry and standalone player-build qualification, including release exclusion of test-only content.

Release content promotion, shipping platforms, release performance and publication readiness.

workItems.implementedOrAcceptedScope: Known recipe4 research/copying, failure/retry evidence, finite supplies, pause/resume and the bounded Research Station are connected.
workItems.remainingCapabilityOrQualification: Broader discovery/training, arbitrary evidence/source acquisition, destructive research and multi-day/general project procedures remain; novel recipes are proposals until approved.
workItems.ownerHold: No new module may start during this documentation-only task.

workItems.title: Haven, markets, settlement, rewards and next descent
workItems.acceptance: No duplicate loot/currency or repeated settlement rewards; preparations affect next expedition.
workItems.implementedOrAcceptedScope: Accepted appraisal, funded sale/meal, expedition bill, episode closure, next-charter planning/acceptance and limited charter execution use one continuing finite ledger.
workItems.remainingCapabilityOrQualification: General markets/title/tax/rewards, broader descent readiness/objectives and production settlement authority remain. Conditional plans do not grant resources, access or automatic rewards.
workItems.ownerHold: No new module may start during this documentation-only task.

workItems.title: Social, language, reputation and factions
workItems.acceptance: No forced player beliefs, hidden data exposure or invented standing from a descriptive label.
workItems.implementedOrAcceptedScope: Social/language/reputation/faction source procedures are mapped; no accepted general gameplay implementation was identified.
workItems.remainingCapabilityOrQualification: Actual communication, declared social goals/checks, relationship/standing/agreement records and finite faction work remain; descriptive lore cannot create standing or force player beliefs.
workItems.ownerHold: No new module may start during this documentation-only task.

workItems.title: World clocks, history, geography, quests and endings
workItems.acceptance: Cycle/endgame triggers and lasting consequences persist; public knowledge stays distinct from internal world truth.
workItems.implementedOrAcceptedScope: Campaign/cosmology/geography/quest/endgame source domains are mapped; shared clock primitives alone are not these world systems.
workItems.remainingCapabilityOrQualification: Required persistent world/quest/cycle/endgame state and public-versus-internal knowledge behavior need exact source contracts and executable coverage.
workItems.ownerHold: No new module may start during this documentation-only task.

workItems.title: Connected explore/encounter/acquire/manage loop
workItems.acceptance: Explore -> encounter -> acquire -> assign/craft/research -> prepare -> explore again; no reset or duplication at boundaries. Dependencies mean source-bound minimum slices, not completion of every boss or area.
workItems.implementedOrAcceptedScope: The selected source-bound headless connected minimum is explicitly ACCEPTED: explore, encounter, finite acquisition, companion work/research/crafting, preparation and continued exploration with save/restore/replay. Later accepted modules extend that real loop.
workItems.remainingCapabilityOrQualification: Broader required combinations/content/actor envelopes and whole-engine completion remain. Do not reopen the accepted minimum or add an unspecified optimization as its retroactive blocker.
workItems.ownerHold: No new module may start during this documentation-only task.

workItems.title: Automated scenarios, parity and balance evidence
workItems.acceptance: Count actual discoveries/passes; source-model validation is not a C# pass; no completion percentage from test count.
workItems.implementedOrAcceptedScope: The independent recipe4 semantic/parity verifier is accepted; current TAC-10 qualification retains 1,584 passing registered cases and five matching 463-command paths.
workItems.remainingCapabilityOrQualification: Independent source expectations and branching coverage for remaining required systems, declared larger operating envelopes and measured reliability/scaling remain. Human balance evidence is a later product activity. Assertion counts are not new registered tests or completion percentages.
workItems.ownerHold: No new module may start during this documentation-only task.

workItems.title: Player explanations, accessibility and Unity presentation
workItems.acceptance: Presentation reads the same resolver; no second rules implementation; Unity integration remains deferred.
workItems.implementedOrAcceptedScope: The pure pending recipe4 quality explanation and existing public command/query/filtered-view boundaries are accepted C# behavior.
workItems.remainingCapabilityOrQualification: Complete necessary C# explanation/query contracts for admitted procedures. Unity views/input/accessibility/audio/art, Editor import/tests and player builds remain a later phase; no presentation rules fork.
workItems.ownerHold: No new module may start during this documentation-only task.
